cases.question: What takes up most of the human day?
cases.technique: Donut: short label in the hole
cases.why: A donut's hole is open room: a short label sits there, no leader. Where the hole is too small, the caption may sit inside a big slice; it is never put on the legend.

cases.question: Which country has the highest share of internet users?
cases.technique: Map, small region by open sea: short label + leader
cases.why: Iceland is too small to find by its outline alone, and the sea beside it is open: a short label on a leader finds it.

chart_spec.title: Iceland has the highest internet use, 95% of people
chart_spec.subtitle: Internet users ÷ population · CIA World Factbook, 2014 edition. Unshaded areas lack data or matching boundaries.

cases.question: Which month was the warmest on record?
cases.technique: Heatmap, no gaps between cells: outline only
cases.why: Every cell is ink; any label covers its neighbours. The outline points and the title names it. The cell has to be in view: on a grid that scrolls, narrow the years first.

chart_spec.title: The warmest month on record was Feb 2016, +1.37 °C
chart_spec.subtitle: Monthly global surface temperature anomalies, 1980–2023 (°C)
